definition: טַל noun masculine Judg 6:37 night-mist, dew (Late Hebrew טַל dew; Aramaic , טַלָּא dew ; Arabic light rain, dew ; Ethiopic dew ) — ׳ ט absolute 1Sam 1:21 + 12 t.; טָ֑ל Judg 6:13 + 9 t.; construct טַל Gen 27:28 + 4 t.; suffix טַלֶּ֑ךָ Isa 26:19 , טַלָּם Zech 8:12 — night-mist , taking place of our dew (see Che Isa 18:4 & Ps 110:3 Lane 1862 , Neil Pal. Explored 129 ); as coming from the sky and bringing fertility, טַל הַשָּׁמַיִם Gen 27:28 (God gives it, נתן ), & v Gen 27:39 (+ מֵעָ֑ל ), compare Deut 33:28 (heavens distil it, ערף ), Hag 1:10 ; Zech 8:12 (heavens give it, נתן ); in Deut 33:13 read perhaps מֵעָ֑ל for מִטַּל (see || Gen 49:25 and Di ); clouds distil it ( רעף ) Prov 3:20 followed by עַל , it descends ( ירד ) upon the camp Num 11:9 ( J E ); it is upon the ground Judg 6:39 ; Judg 6:40 , compare 2Sam 1:21 (+ מָטָר ); upon the fleece Judg 6:37 is wrung out ( מוץ ) of the fleece v Judg 6:38 remains through the night ( לון ) Job 29:19 , compare ׳ שִׁכְבַת הַטּ the lying of dew = the dew lying Exod 16:13 ; Exod 16:14 ( P ; it goes up ( עלה ) in morning); it is in drops מִי הוֺלִיד אֶגְלֵי טָ֑ל Job 38:28 covers the head of one out at night Song 5:2 it comes ( היה ) by word of prophet 1Kgs 17:1 (+ מָטָר ); simile of stealthy approach כַּאֲשֶׁר יִפֹּל הַטַּל עַלהָֿאֲדָמָה 2Sam 17:12 simile denoting welcome and gentle refreshment, of speech, which distils ( נזל ) like it Deut 32:2 (poem; || שְׂעִירִים , רְבִיבִים ); of fraternal unity כְּטַל חֶרְמוֺן Ps 133:3 ( ירד על ); of king's favour Prov 19:12 ( על ); of ׳ י 's kindness Hos 14:6 כְּעָב טַל Isa 18:4 like a mist-cloud , of ׳ י 's quiet watching; of Jacob's influence among nations Mic 5:6 ( ׳ מֵאֵת י ׳ ט ; || רְבִיבִים ); טַל אוֺרֹת טַלֶּ֑ךָ Isa 26:19 a dew of light is thy dew (see I. אוֺרָה , p. 21:b above and Baud Stud. Semitic Rel. ii. 264 f. ); as transitory, כַּטַּל מַשְׁכִּים הֹלֵךְ Hos 6:4 like the dew early departing , so Hos 13:3 (both || עַנַןבֹּֿקֶר ); figurative of young warriors of king established by ׳ י , with flashing weapons, like dewdrops טַל יַלְדֻתֶ֑ךָ Ps 110:3 .
